(1)

Represents the shares of common stock, $0.0001 par value per share of Vigil Neuroscience, Inc. (the “Company”) issuable upon conversion of the Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock of the Company, which the selling stockholder may at any time choose to convert and offer for resale pursuant to the prospectus to which this exhibit is attached. Pursuant to Rule 416 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), the registrant is also registering an indeterminate number of additional shares of common stock issuable by reason of any stock dividend, stock split, recapitalization or other similar transaction.

(2)

Estimated solely for the purpose of calculating the registration fee in accordance with Rule 457(c) under the Securities Act. The price per share and aggregate offering price are based on the average of the high and low prices of the registrant’s common stock on March 26, 2025, as reported on The Nasdaq Global Select Market.
